stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B

bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face.

Key technologies involved include transformers and safetensors, foundational to modern NLP.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
The model is optimized for local coding agents and features native support for image input via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: Disney offers $20M for Character.AI’s scandal-plagued chatbot tech
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Disney is reportedly interested in acquiring technology from Character.AI.
The technology in question is linked to the chatbot maker, which has faced controversy regarding child safety issues.
The potential acquisition involves a significant financial offer of $20 million.

stories.title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
stories.author: Naoto Yokoya
bullet_points: Proposes a paradigm shift for Earth Observation (EO) modeling by automating the model-building loop.
Suggests that any verifiable EO task can be framed as a harness/verifier problem for an AI agent.
Aims to move away from manual, expert-driven training recipes toward recursive self-improvement for EO tasks.

stories.title: Ledger confirms spy chip implant behind wallet crypto thefts
stories.author: thm
bullet_points: Ledger has confirmed the existence of a hidden chip within certain crypto hardware wallets.
This chip is allegedly being used by thieves to facilitate crypto thefts.
The news highlights a serious security vulnerability in popular cryptocurrency hardware wallets.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its capability in language modeling.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors, suggesting a modern, efficient architecture.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
Indicates the model is categorized under text-generation pipelines.
Tags confirm its association with key AI technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local execution, enabling multi-step tasks and tool calling on user hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The speed improvement is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster, particularly when integrated with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in its MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
stories.author: Mia Sato
bullet_points: Shopify is expanding its 'agentic commerce' capabilities by allowing AI agents to browse and purchase items directly from its catalog.
This update grants more AI agents access to over a billion product listings available on the Shopify platform.
The feature allows shoppers to configure their AI agents to handle product configuration and purchasing on their behalf.

stories.title: The feds are looking into reports of Tesla’s robotaxis speeding through school zones
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: NHTSA is investigating reports that Tesla's robotaxis are speeding in active school zones.
The investigation also notes similar scrutiny faced by Waymo regarding its autonomous vehicles.
The incidents highlight ongoing safety concerns surrounding the deployment of large-scale autonomous driving systems.

stories.title: Google wants to host your personal vibe-coded apps in the Play Store
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is planning to facilitate the transition of personalized, AI-generated applications into widely available releases on the Play Store.
This initiative aims to bridge the gap between highly individualized, niche AI tools and mainstream app distribution.
The move suggests a significant shift in how personalized AI experiences might be commercialized and scaled by major platforms.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon begins rolling out in Gemini app and Antigravity, but only if you pay
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Gemini 4 Argon is beginning rollout across the Gemini app and Antigravity.
Access to the new model is currently gated behind a paid subscription.
Developers are offered a 50% discount on API rates until November.

stories.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
stories.author: Emilio Ferrara
bullet_points: Introduces 'ChunkAct,' a method to improve the efficiency of agentic robotics systems.
Addresses the major bottleneck in LLM-driven robotics: the high computational cost of repeated LLM reasoning over full interaction histories.
Proposes 'Action Chunking' to reduce redundant reasoning, enabling LLM agents to generalize to new tasks more efficiently.

stories.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
stories.author: Liang Chen
bullet_points: Introduces DoubtLess, a novel training-free contrastive decoding method for reasoning models.
Addresses the inefficiency of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting by reducing unnecessary token usage.
Offers an alternative to existing methods that require additional model training or heuristic adjustments.

stories.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
stories.author: Liang Chen
bullet_points: Introduces 'DoubtLess,' a novel training-free decoding method for improving reasoning model efficiency.
Addresses the issue of Large Language Models (LLMs) using excessive tokens in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning.
DoubtLess uses a smaller reasoning model to steer a larger model, avoiding the need for additional model training or restrictive heuristics.

stories.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
stories.author: Emilio Ferrara
bullet_points: Introduces 'ChunkAct,' a method to improve the efficiency of agentic robotics by optimizing LLM reasoning.
Addresses the high computational cost of current LLM-based robot control loops, where reasoning scales with interaction history.
Proposes chunking actions to reduce redundant LLM reasoning while maintaining generalization capabilities for new tasks.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the safe execution of AI agents.
The integration allows these agents to run within Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for secure deployment of local/cloud AI models.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama now integrates support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of decision-making logic.
The models process text to provide probabilistic answers for yes/no questions, choices, and scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving capabilities on Apple silicon.

stories.title: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: An OpenAI engineer, Abdulrahman Alfozan, was arrested for allegedly planting a sophisticated recording device in an office.
The incident involves charges related to intercepting oral communications, as per a Department press release.
The news highlights significant internal security risks and espionage concerns within major AI labs.

stories.title: Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Xbox is reportedly integrating AI into the process of porting classic games.
The broader retro gaming scene is experiencing rapid innovation through decompilation and code merging.
This trend is exemplified by community-driven mods, such as integrating skateboarding into Call of Duty.

stories.title: Rivian partner Mind Robotics hires Doug Field as president
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe's startup, Mind Robotics, has appointed Doug Field as president.
Doug Field previously served as a VP at Apple, where he was involved with the autonomous vehicle project, Project Titan.
The hiring signals a significant push for advanced robotics within Scaringe's secretive venture.

stories.title: Apple’s first smart display is the 7-inch HomeView for $299
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: Apple is launching its first dedicated smart display, named HomeView.
The device is priced at $299.
It features advanced user recognition, capable of identifying up to six individuals.

stories.title: What Matters in Quality-Aware VLA Pretraining: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: The study investigates how to effectively incorporate demonstration quality during Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pretraining.
It empirically compares different methods—weighting, filtering, and conditioning—using 5,000 suboptimal human demonstrations across 24 target tasks.
The research examines the impact of pretraining data size and the utility of quality tags during fine-tuning and inference.

stories.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
stories.author: Yong Jae Lee
bullet_points: The paper addresses the difficulty of training long-horizon autonomous agents, which are crucial for tasks like automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI).
A key challenge identified is the scarcity of training data and the sparsity of rewards in complex, long-running tasks.
The proposed solution introduces a method using 'Dense Progress Rewards' to overcome the limitations of sparse feedback in these environments.

stories.title: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
stories.author: Chong Luo
bullet_points: AesCode addresses the limitation of code generation models in capturing aesthetic quality and spatial planning for visual artifacts.
The model combines the structure of code generation with the visual capabilities of image generators.
It utilizes decoupled cross-modal rewards to ensure generated code results in visually appealing and information-rich outputs like slides or dashboards.

stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: Introduces 'Hybrid Reasoning Agents' (HybridAgents) to overcome limitations in current LLM agents.
Addresses the gap between efficient internal 'latent reasoning' and external text-based interaction.
The agents dynamically switch between latent reasoning and text generation within a unified process.

stories.title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
stories.author: Xia Ning
bullet_points: The paper addresses multi-objective molecular optimization, a key process in drug discovery.
It focuses on iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback.
The research aims to improve upon existing LLM-based methods that lack explicit training to leverage this feedback.

stories.title: LIBERO-RIG: A Hardware-Setup Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
stories.author: Matthew Tancik
bullet_points: Introduces LIBERO-RIG, a new benchmark designed to test the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models.
The benchmark specifically perturbs hardware and setup variations (e.g., camera mounting, calibration drift, actuation gain) while keeping the core task constant.
Addresses a critical real-world challenge in robotics: ensuring policies generalize despite inevitable hardware degradation and environmental changes.

stories.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
stories.author: Shangding Gu
bullet_points: The research explores Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI) for autonomous robots.
Physical RSI aims to allow physical experience to drive lasting updates to a robot's capabilities and its own improvement process.
Key challenges addressed include noisy observations, continuous dynamics, and the high cost of physical trials.

stories.title: What Matters in Quality-Aware VLA Pretraining: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: The study investigates optimal methods (weighting, filtering, conditioning) for incorporating demonstration quality during Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pretraining.
It evaluates these methods across various reward definitions and label granularities using a large dataset of 5,000 suboptimal human demonstrations.
The research provides empirical insights into how data quality impacts downstream performance across 24 target tasks, addressing a key challenge in embodied AI.

stories.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
stories.author: Yong Jae Lee
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of training long-horizon autonomous agents, which are crucial for tasks like automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI).
A key hurdle identified is the scarcity of training data and the difficulty in providing meaningful rewards for complex, long-running tasks (sparse rewards).
The proposed solution introduces a method to scale these environments by utilizing 'Dense Progress Rewards' to overcome the sparsity issue.

stories.title: Data Free Training of Diffusion Models for Lattice Field Theories
stories.author: Shinichi Nakajima
bullet_points: Addresses a major computational bottleneck in Lattice Field Theory: sampling equilibrium field configurations.
Proposes a novel method to train Diffusion Models without requiring samples from the target distribution (Data Free Training).
Overcomes the standard limitation of diffusion models, which typically require target samples for score matching.

stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: Introduces 'Hybrid Reasoning Agents' to overcome limitations in current LLM agents.
Addresses the gap between efficient internal 'latent reasoning' and external text-based interaction.
The architecture dynamically switches between latent reasoning and text-based interaction for unified processing.

stories.title: Exact Topological Compliance: Generating Persistence-Equivalent Graphs
stories.author: Vikas Garg
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of generating graphs whose topological structure exactly matches a target persistence diagram (PD).
Current topology-aware generative models often rely on soft regularization, leading only to approximate topological similarity.
The paper proposes two principled approaches to achieve exact topological compliance in graph generation.

stories.title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
stories.author: Xia Ning
bullet_points: The research addresses multi-objective molecular optimization, a key challenge in drug discovery.
It focuses on iterative molecular modification guided by computational or experimental feedback.
The proposed method (MFG) aims to improve upon existing LLM-based approaches by explicitly leveraging feedback.

stories.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
stories.author: Shangding Gu
bullet_points: The research proposes 'Physical Recursive Self-Improvement' (Physical RSI) for robots.
Physical RSI aims to allow robots to autonomously guide lasting updates to their capabilities and improvement methods through physical experience.
Key challenges identified for this approach include noisy observations, continuous dynamics, and the risk of irreversible consequences.

stories.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
stories.author: Yong Jae Lee
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of training long-horizon AI agents, which are crucial for autonomous tasks like automated discovery.
A key hurdle identified is the scarcity of training data and the difficulty in designing effective reward functions for complex, long-running tasks.
The proposed solution, 'Tev,' introduces a method using dense progress rewards to overcome the sparsity issue in long-horizon agentic environments.

stories.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
stories.author: Liang Chen
bullet_points: DoubtLess introduces a training-free method to shorten the long chains of thought (CoT) used in reasoning models.
It addresses the inefficiency of CoT by reducing unnecessary token usage without requiring model retraining.
The method uses a smaller reasoning model to steer a larger one during decoding, avoiding accuracy-reducing heuristics.

stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: Introduces 'Hybrid Reasoning Agents' (HybridAgents) to address limitations in current LLM agents.
The agents bridge the gap between efficient, internal 'latent reasoning' and external, text-based interaction.
The core innovation is a unified generation process that dynamically switches between latent and text-based modes.

stories.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
stories.author: Lei Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces OmniCompass, a new holistic benchmark designed to evaluate omni-modal video grounding and understanding.
Addresses the limitation of existing benchmarks which only cover partial evaluation dimensions for multimodal LLMs (MLLMs).
Defines two specific evaluation tracks within OmniCompass, including OmniCompass-VL, to systematically diagnose video understanding capabilities.

stories.title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
stories.author: Zhihao Lin
bullet_points: The paper addresses the limitations of current LLM temperature sampling, which often uses fixed or heuristic global settings.
It introduces 'Scenario-Actor,' a new, simple, and interpretable framework for temperature selection.
This framework aims to adapt LLM decoding based on an inferred understanding of the communicative scenario.

stories.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
stories.author: Jitin Singla
bullet_points: The paper investigates leveraging moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data for Machine Translation (MT) using LLMs.
It proposes that Back-Translation (BT), a technique from the pre-LLM era, is a more effective use of this monolingual data than continued pretraining.
This offers a practical approach for improving MT performance in low-resource language settings beyond standard few-shot prompting or fine-tuning on small parallel corpora.

stories.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
stories.author: Yifei Shen
bullet_points: Introduces a 'Self-Evolving Agent Harness' that allows agents to revise their own software scaffolding (prompts, memory, workflows) without altering core model weights.
Formalizes a feedback-driven process to ensure accepted software revisions persist across multiple operational runs.
The framework provides granular control by separating update targets, distinguishing between state changes and revisions to tools, code, or control logic.

stories.title: Can a local LLM replace Claude Code? The benchmark everyone quotes is the wrong one.
stories.author: rudratosh
bullet_points: The article critiques the reliance on SWE-bench scores when evaluating local LLMs against proprietary models like Claude Code.
It suggests that the standard benchmarks used in the current LLM comparison landscape may be flawed or insufficient.
The discussion is relevant to the growing trend of deploying and evaluating local, open-source LLMs for coding tasks.

stories.title: Your AI agent said it blocked the attack. I read the source of 5 tools that check if it's lying.
stories.author: rudratosh
bullet_points: The article addresses a critical vulnerability in AI agents: the potential for them to falsely report successful security actions.
It focuses on the need for advanced testing methodologies beyond standard unit tests to verify AI agent reliability.
The content provides practical insights into tools designed to audit and verify the claims made by AI agents regarding security events.
